correction.recorded: 2026-09-15 (after submission, follow-up measurement in the same warm sandbox)
correction.changes: the REASON recorded for the failed criterion 1, not the verdict (still failed)
correction.wrongEarlierAttribution: the channel captures its renderer facade once at construction (channel.ts:255-259) with no local fallback
correction.correctedMechanism: the host refuses renderers for event types it considers built-in; plugin event types already persisted by a previous boot land in that built-in snapshot (dsh-adapter/renderers.ts: BUILTIN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES = new Set(KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES) at module load, then the built-in refusal path). A plugin renderer therefore works only for a never-before-seen type, on the first boot that uses it — a stable renderer line is not attainable for any type this bundle appends.
correction.proof: evidence/tui/plugin/20260915T060934Z/mount/renderer-type-probe/ (probe4..probe9 + reports; probe9 is decisive: previously-used name invisible, never-used name and control visible in the SAME boot/session/payload shape)
correction.whatIsProvenWorking: the tuiRenderers seam itself, this package registration shape (identity arg + scoped.effect cleanup), the transcript projection, and the plugin event append — all demonstrated with fresh type names (probe4, probe5, probe7)
correction.consequence: no package-side change can make our own renderer line stable; the honest disposition is NOT-CLAIMED for the renderer line, with the host behaviour reported upstream (t11-style research).
